items.title: YouArt Desktop App
items.source_text: YouArt Desktop App Codex for creative team Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly. From feature launch videos to viral remakes and clips from your long videos, it takes the whole job end to end. Bring your own API keys, and smart routing sends every shot to the cheapest provider. items.title: Templify AI
items.source_text: Templify AI Powerful content editor for people who aren’t editors Templify is an all-in-one video, photo, and carousel editor for iPhone. With 1,200+ designer templates, it turns clips and photos into Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and collages in minutes, no timeline needed. Features include AI video editing, beat-synced transitions, auto captions, background removal, filters, and an AI Studio. Free to use, with an optional Pro subscription. Social Media Photography Photo & Video

items.title: Omnigraph
items.source_text: Omnigraph Open source graph database for your AI agents Omnigraph is an open-source object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology. It allows AI agents safely collaborate on shared knowledge. Give agents one typed graph with Git-like branching, review, and merge for every write, so changes can be validated before becoming shared context. Run it on your own S3-compatible storage, with semantic, keyword, and hybrid search plus graph traversal in one query. No hosted memory API or proprietary storage required. Open Source Developer Tools Database
